acceptanceObjective: Migrate the DesktopPet PhysicsRoot writer into the global single-lease boundary without changing gravity, landing, bounds, pause, or action-lock behavior; preserve read-only DesktopBodySnapshot observation and prove recovery on cancellation and teardown.
constraints: Keep one global active input lease; do not add resource-level parallelism or preemption.
Do not expose raw Live2D Param* values or a new LLM/tool entry point.
PhysicsRoot remains distinct from Live2D BodyRoot parameters and DesktopBodySnapshot remains read-only.
Preserve physics-before-Cubism-Physics and visual-after-Physics ordering where the writer crosses into renderer behavior.
Cancellation, action handoff, pause/resume, renderer disable, application quit, and destruction must release or safely recover the owner.
notes: Follow-up design package only. Do not implement this migration as part of the walking lease task. Use isolated FU_XUAN_DATA/.test_mode evidence and report unrelated environment failures separately.
